page0.text:
"...All right."
I'll go search the first floor.
I feel bad for leaving the Servant to Saber alone, but she should be able to fight by herself.

page1.text:
"...Saber, I'll leave the Servant to you. You can handle it on your own?"
"Of course. What will you do, Shirou?"

page2.text: "I'll hurry down to the first floor with Tohsaka. It would be dangerous by myself, but I should be fine if I'm with her. Besides, she's the one that can detect magical energy. Let's go."

page3.text:
"Huh... Y-yeah, right. I was planning to without your go-ahead."
It's decided.
So now...

page4.text:
"Hey, what are you doing!? Are you insane, breaking the leg of a chair like that?"
"We should be armed, right? I can only use Strengthening, so I need something."

page5.text:
I swing the leg of the chair I broke off.
It's like I'm recreating what happened that one time with Tohsaka.
My success rate seems to be going up, as I easily manage this time. So I grab another leg just in case.

page6.text:
"Shirou. I feel a faint presence outside. It seems like we are surrounded."
"Huh!? Surrounded by what!?"
"I don't know. However, we simply need to go outside and check."

page7.text:
"...You're right. Can you take the lead?"
"Of course. It is my duty to be your shield."
Saber jumps out into the hallway.

page8.text: "Let's go, Tohsaka... We'll press on to the first floor!"

page9.text:
What the hell?
The instant we go out into the hallway, we find out what's surrounding us.
Are those bones?
Puppets made out of inhuman bones swarm from the other side of the hallway...!

page10.text:
"Tohsaka, what are those...!?"
"Golems! A type of familiar! Get over here! They won't be a match for Saber no matter how many of them there are!"
"Ugh... Sorry, Saber!"

page11.text:
I run to the stairs.
The sound of Saber crushing the strange bone puppets echoes through the hall behind me.

page12.text:
We go down the stairs.
It's not far from the fourth floor to the first.
However...

page13.text:
"Damn...you...!"
I smash the bone dolls blocking my way with the chair leg in my hand.

page14.text:
"Haah... Haah, haah...!"
This is the third one already.
Maybe it's because of the horrible state of this place, but I don't even care about the violence overtaking us.

page15.text:
My mind has gone numb.
Hatred, fear, sadness, cowardice...all of it has locked up in my brain.
The only thing I can think of is to make it to the first floor.
I'll just keep on swinging these two weapons in my hands just like him!

page16.text:
"Oh no you don't...!"
I mow down the fourth body of bones.
The bone puppet that tried to attack Tohsaka from one side crumbles as it crashes into the wall.

page17.text:
"Hey, are you okay, Tohsaka!?"
...
Good, she's fine...!

page18.text:
"Where's the origin of the field!?"
"Y-yeah, it's right there! That classroom!"
Tohsaka points at a room about ten meters ahead.
There are a few more bone puppets that followed us down the stairs.
But we don't have the time to deal with them...!

page19.text:
I parry the attacking sword with the weapon in my right hand.
Then slash the exposed body with the weapon in my left.

page20.text:
The fifth bone artifice crumbles.
But they just keep coming.
There's still more than ten of them swarming the hallway...!

page21.text:
"Damn it, they're persistent...! When will you guys run out...!"
I retreat a bit.
The chair legs in my hands are worn down.
Even though I Strengthened them, they're originally just stainless steel.
I don't know if they can take one more attack...

page22.text:
"Get back, Shirou...!"
"Huh...?"
I'm surprised, but I retreat like I'm told.

page24.text:
...
Was that some kind of release incantation?
There are no sign of destruction in the hallway, and only the scattered remains of the bone figures are there.

page25.text:
"Thanks, you gave me time. I rarely use topaz, so it took me a while to get it ready.
...To be honest, I would've been overwhelmed if you weren't here."
She drops her shoulders in relief.
But she only does so for an instant and glares at the classroom.

page26.text:
"Let's go. Shinji should be there."
Tohsaka runs to our destination.
I follow her and step inside the red classroom.

page28.text:
The air filling the classroom cannot be called a gas anymore.
The vaporized blood dyes the eyes of onlookers like paint.
I hear voices of anguish from all directions.

page29.text:
This is the source of the Bounded Field, the place where absorption is strongest.
The students collapsed on the floor are entirely different to the students on the fourth floor.
...The groans that I hear are just my imagination.
The fainted students have pale faces and are still as wax figures.

page30.text:
Tohsaka just gazes at the scene, her legs shaking.
A clicking sound.
It must be to suppress her emotions. Tohsaka chatters her teeth as she beholds this horror.

page31.text:
...
She lifts her shaking leg and moves forward.
Between the desks...
There is one clearly animated person.
Sitting hunched amongst the fallen students, Shinji Matou looks up at Tohsaka.

page32.text:
"Shinji, you...!"
A stern voice.
He must have reacted to that.
Shinji lets out a strangled cry and clambers away from Tohsaka.

page33.text:
"...No excuses. I'll do whatever it takes to make you pay for what you've done."
Tohsaka approaches Shinji.

page34.text:
"N-no, no no no no no...! It's not me, it's not me, it's not me, it's not me...!!!"
He shakes his head violently and backs up to the wall.

page35.text:
"Not you...? Are you serious?
Release the Bounded Field. If you don't, then I'm going to blow that face of yours to hell and—"
"Ah... W-w-w-wait, no, I said no, it's not me, it isn't! I'm not the one who killed her...!!!"

page36.text:
"...Eh?"
Stranger and stranger.
Shinji flees from Tohsaka, but not really.
He's looking at the floor...at our feet.

page37.text:
"Why there...?"
I look down.
The only thing there are the students lying unconscious on the floor.
Other than that, there's nothing...else...

page38.text:
"...Tohsaka."
I call to her and point.

page39.text:
"Huh...?"
A stunned voice.
Her anger toward Shinji turns to confusion.
The moment she sees the thing lying on the floor, the animosity fades.

page40.text:
"..."
My breathing catches.
The thing collapsed on the floor is completely dead.
Long purple hair...
The woman in black... The Servant who attacked me, Rider.

page41.text:
"She's...dead."
Tohsaka's voice is flat, emotionless.
"I said it's not me. I didn't do it. I activated the Bounded Field and no one was able to move, but Rider...Rider was..."

page42.text:
This Servant in black—Rider—was killed with one blow.
What kind of weapon was it? How was she killed?

page43.text:
Only one blow against a Servant.
It was a single strike to the neck, which was ripped to pieces.
...I can't imagine how that happened.
She must've been caught by surprise, but the enemy must've been skilled to sever her spine in one blow.

page44.text:
...No, it was more than severed.
It's as if her head was set in a vice and then her neck was twisted, muscle, bone, and all.

page45.text:
Rider disappears.
At the same time, the red world fades away.
It seems like the field was set up by the Servant after all.
However...

page46.text:
"Shinji. Who did this?"
"Eek..."
Shinji inches back to the hallway, cornered by Tohsaka.

page47.text:
"I told you that there's one more Master at school. It's your fault for ignoring my warning and causing a commotion.
...Heh. It looks like you left your Servant to die and survived, but it's your turn now that I found you. I don't know what kind of Master you are, but I'll finish you off next time for sure."

page48.text: "Guh...! A-as if! I don't have a Servant anymore! I'm not a Master, so you guys will be the only ones that will be targeted...!"

page49.text:
"Mmm, sure. I suppose you're right. There's no harm in letting you go even if you still have your Command Spells.
It might be unsightly to see you running around, but a single, harmless gnat isn't gonna kill a person.
...Yeah. I won't kill you here, depending on your response."

page50.text:
"H-harmless? A gnat...me...?"
"Hey, it's a step below a pest, even.
Shinji Matou is not a mage nor a Master. You're not even an annoyance."

page51.text:
"...So. Tell me what you saw. That's your only value right now."
"...Guh, ungh...!"
Shinji scrambles back, Tohsaka's very presence a threat.

page52.text:
Well, I don't even know if she'd actually follow through with her threat.
...But.
She's seriously angry.
She's lost control of herself seeing this nightmare.

page53.text:
"Come on...! What kind of Servant finished off your Servant, Shinji!?"
"Ugh... I-I don't know, stupid! Y-you guys are the one who should be scared! You guys will be their next targets...!!!"

page54.text:
"You...!"
Shinji runs out into the hallway and Tohsaka starts to go after him.

page55.text:
She stops, though.
It seems to occur to her there what she has to deal with.

page56.text:
...No, that's wrong.
It's not like it just occurred.
She clenches her teeth, looking back at the collapsed student body in frustration.

page57.text:
...
Her expression is somewhat typical of her.
But her knees are shaking and her eyes are wavering so much that she looks like she's going to cry.

page58.text:
...
...I can't tell if she's more angry or sad.
But I'm convinced.
She has a strong attitude, can do anything, and is a distinguished mage.
But deep down, she is just a girl that acts her age.

page59.text:
"...It's okay, Tohsaka. Everyone's still breathing. It's not like it's over."
"Huh...? Everyone's breathing...?"

page60.text:
"Yeah. I know it's hard, but look closely. Everyone is still alive. The field is gone, so all we have to do now is call for help."
So. Do we call the ambulance or somewhere else in this case? Should we contact the church if they're injuries caused by magecraft?"

page61.text:
I ask in a calm voice.
It seems like she was finally able to regain her senses, as Tohsaka slaps her own face with both hands.

page62.text:
"You can contact the church. If we explain the situation to Kirei, he can do the rest."
"All right. Then let's call him right away."
Tohsaka nods and dashes into the hall.
Her destination must be the office.
There's a phone there so she can make a call right away.

page63.text:
We finish contacting the church and go outside.
It'll be a problem later if we're found to be the only ones unharmed, so Kirei ordered us to pretend like we weren't at school today.

page64.text:
"So Saber, you were fighting Caster?"
"Yes. It was the Caster-class Servant controlling those golems. I defeated the Caster who was hiding at school, but that must have only been her shadow."

page65.text:
...
...I see.
So it means that Caster was controlling those golems from Ryudou Temple.
Then there's no doubt that Caster was the one who attacked Shinji's Servant.

page66.text:
"...So the fourth Master at school is Caster's Master, huh? It's possible that she used Shinji to lure Rider into a trap."
"...That is the likely situation. You say Rider had her head cut off in one blow. I can only think that something was restraining her and that she died without resisting."

page67.text:
"...That's worrying. But we found out that Caster's Master is at school. It wasn't completely a waste."
I turn to Tohsaka for confirmation.

page68.text:
Tohsaka only stares back at me silently.
Ever since we left the classroom, she's been looking at me as if she wants to say something.

page69.text:
"Tohsaka, if you have something to say, say it. I get the willies when you look at me like that."
Um, I get worried about when I'll get hit from behind.

page70.text:
...
Tohsaka still stares at me for a while. Then, with a serious expression...
"You're pretty calm, Emiya. It's a bit unexpected."
She says.

page71.text:
"Eh? No way, I've been a basket case. I'm still really pissed off too, we both are, aren't we?"
"Even then, you were able to figure out everyone's condition. I couldn't do that."

page72.text:
"Mm? Oh, that's nothing. I'm used to seeing corpses, so I can tell."
"Huh? Used to seeing corpses...?"
